items.statement: Secured liver transplant license for Bengaluru hub; performed first pediatric liver transplant at Chennai hub
items.quote: I'm pleased to share that we successfully performed our first pediatric liver transplant at our Chennai hub hospital. Additionally, we secured a liver transplant license for our Bengaluru hub—a significant step in building Chennai and Bengaluru into tertiary and quaternary care hubs.

items.statement: International revenue declined to INR 30.7 crores in FY25 from INR 44 crores in FY24 due to permit issues in Bangladesh, Oman, Kenya, Sudan
items.quote: We continue to face challenges in our international business, particularly in countries such as Bangladesh, Oman, Kenya, and Sudan, where there has been a significant decline in the issuance of healthcare permits for patients seeking medical travel. For the year, international revenue stood at INR 30.7 crores, compared to INR 44 crores last year.

items.statement: Mature hospital occupancy 52.2%, new hospital occupancy 35.6% in Q4 FY25; overall 46.5%
items.quote: Our overall occupancy rate for the quarter was 46.5%. Mature hospitals recorded 52.2% occupancy, while new hospitals posted a 35.6% rate.

items.statement: Hyderabad unit broke even in 12 months; Bangalore and Chennai target 15-18 months
items.quote: The Hyderabad unit has broken even, in line with our usual timeline of 12 months. For Bangalore and Chennai, the trajectory is similar — we usually target break-even within 15 to 18 months depending on the cluster.

items.statement: Seasonality impacts quarterly performance; pediatric volumes can be subdued in certain quarters
items.quote: Seasonality will always play a role in our business. We are primarily a medical hospital — around 75–80% of our work is medical, and only about 20% is surgical. We are not a wear-and-tear hospital; we are emergency-driven and community-based hospital. seasons always play out either positively or negatively.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR575 crores, split roughly 40% export and 60% domestic
items.quote: And on the side of order book, it's roughly INR575 crores of order book currently, which is more or less split between 40% roughly on the side of export and balance on the side of domestic.

items.statement: Revenue growth expected above 20% for FY26 and FY27; EBITDA margin guidance 16-18%
items.quote: we believe for each year FY '26 and '27, it should be a growth on a top line around more than 20% sort of number. And on the side of EBITDA, on a margin basis just an indicative number, you can take between 16% to 18%.

items.statement: FY26 capex around INR120 crores; FY27 predominantly maintenance capex
items.quote: For the -- current FY '26 it should be around INR120-odd crores.

items.statement: Blended utilization expected around 80% in FY26; seamless utilization 85-90%
items.quote: Yes, definitely, it should be blended basically it should be around 80%, sort number what we believe we should be able to achieve and primarily more than 85%-90% on the side of seamless.

items.statement: Domestic demand subdued in FY25 but showing recovery signs with new orders from power and other sectors
items.quote: But recently, you must have seen that we've received a substantial amount of domestic order which also shows that there is a good amount of demand from power and also other sector may come in the going Venus Pipes and forward quarter

items.statement: Exports grew 3x to INR338 crores (35% of revenue) in FY25; key geographies Europe, US, Middle East, Africa
items.quote: export business. Export reve nues grew more than 3x from INR98.7 crores in FY24 to INR338 crores in FY25. Out of this, INR112.5 crores came in the fourth quarter alone. Exports made up about 35% of our total revenue for the year

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA margin 17.5%; Q4 FY25 margin 16.1%; welded margins lower due to export penetration and competition
items.quote: For FY25, EBITDA grew 14.6%, reaching INR167.6 crores with a margin of 17.5%.

items.statement: Seamless pipes 57% of FY25 revenue (18% growth), welded pipes 36% (12% growth); value-added welded tubes 3,600 MTPA commenced
items.quote: Seamless pipes contributed INR543 crores, growing by 18% and welded pipe business contributed INR350 crores in revenues, growing by 12% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Major order INR190 crores from leading power equipment manufacturer for supercritical/subcritical boiler tubes over 12-15 months
items.quote: We are proud to share that we have recently secured a major order worth INR190 crores from India's leading integrated power plant equipment manufacturer. The order is for stainless steel seamless boiler tubes to be used in the series of supercritical and subcritical thermal power projects. The project is expected to be executed progressively over the next 12 to 15 months.

items.statement: Competitors entering seamless pipes but approval-driven business creates barriers; Ratnamani makes value-added welded products
items.quote: Yes, definitely few of the competition will be coming and a few are under process. But again, as we always say it's an approval-driven business, so everybody should be requiring the requisite approval for getting supply to the end customer or key customers.

items.statement: Strategic recruitment of experienced talent increased manpower cost; investments intentional for long-term market share gains
items.quote: The recruitment of key manpower is our strategic initiative and strengthening our market position. Over the past few years, we have consistently invested in b uilding a strong team, which is reflected in the increase in our manpower cost

items.statement: Blended realization INR340+ per kg excluding other sales; blended EBITDA ~INR64-65 per kg
items.quote: On a blended basis, it was around INR340 -- more than INR340 per kg, excluding other sales.

items.statement: Total volume 26,000 tons in FY25 (17% growth); seamless volume up 25%, welded up 10%
items.quote: It was around 26,000 tons on a total basis.

items.statement: US tariffs on China benefit Indian exports; further increases could help but scenario unclear
items.quote: Definitely, it can be because what we are seeing in case of U.S.A., already a good amount of duties are there on China when they export to U.S. as compared to India. But then if it is further increased, definitely we believe it should help.

items.statement: No incremental US tariff impact on products; tariff scenario changing weekly, hard to predict
items.quote: No, no, you're right. The tariff remain the same for India as compared to what it was earlier so as a company or as a country we are not affected on our product side.

items.statement: Other expenses plus employee cost expected 16-18% on blended basis going forward
items.quote: But if you see on a blended basis, welded and seamless taken together, other expenses plus employee cost should be in the range of 16% to 18%.

items.statement: Value-added welded tubes 3,600 MTPA commenced operations; fittings capacity 300 tons part of expansion
items.quote: Secondly, we have also achieved a significant milestone with the commencement of operation for 3,600 metric tons per annum of value-added welded tubes.

items.statement: Value-added welded products margin delta 2-5% higher from selling price; limited to 300 tons of 2,300 total capacity
items.quote: And the margin delta generally as and when you get those requisite approvals, it it can vary to a certain extent, can be 2% or higher, 3%. It can be a sort of that range 2% to 5%, you can say.

items.statement: Export channel: Europe/US via dealers/distributors; Middle East/Africa via EPC contractors with end-customer approvals
items.quote: So primarily in Europe and US dealer and distributor only. They in turn supply to the end industry.

items.statement: Blended volume growth guidance ~20% for FY26
items.quote: On a blended basis, we see a growth of around 20% for the coming year.

items.statement: No plan to backward integrate into stainless steel bars currently
items.quote: No, currently we don't have any such plan. but if something is there or if wee finalize something, we will definitely let you know.

items.statement: Boiler tube tenders expected over next 3 years; piercing technology accepted for supercritical orders
items.quote: But we think it's a good amount of seamless demand in the coming 3 years, it will be quite a significant what we believe.

items.statement: Targeting 3x EBITDA of FY25 by FY29
items.quote: we are targeting an increase in EBITDA by about 3x of FY25 numbers by FY29

items.statement: INR130 crore capex for grain-based ethanol facility in FY26 net of GST
items.quote: For FY '26, we are investing currently in the grain-based ethanol facility for which our capital expenditure was estimated to be INR130 crores. That is net of GST.

items.statement: 200 KL/day grain/maize distillery expected commissioning in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Our 200-kiloliter-per-day fungible grain/maize distillery is expected to be commissioned in Q4 financial year 26.

items.statement: Biobased chemicals EBITDA grew more than 2x in FY25
items.quote: In FY25, the EBITDA for biobased chemicals grew more than 2x.

items.statement: Q4 FY25 EBITDA margin 21%, up 80 bps YoY
items.quote: our EBITDA for Q4 FY25 was INR122 crores, achieving a robust margin of 21%, an increase of 80 basis points compared to 20.2% in the corresponding period last year, Q4 FY24.

items.statement: Licensed biobutanol technology from Catalyxx for 30,000 tons in phases, first phase 15,000 tons
items.quote: We have done this license for 30,000 tons and we were implementing it in phases, which is first phase to be 15,000 tons.

items.statement: Seeing demand for bio-based specialty chemicals, debottlenecking capacity to meet it
items.quote: We are seeing that demand and we are working on debottlenecking chemical capacity to meet that demand.

items.statement: Strategic shift to reduce ethyl acetate reliance and increase bio-based specialty chemicals ratio
items.quote: The other strategic shift is to add bio-based chemicals, which are in the Spec chemical space, and so reduce the amount of ethyl acetate reliance we have and increase the ratio of bio-based spec chemicals.

items.statement: Government allowed uniform sugar export quota of 1 million tons in February, improving domestic sugar prices
items.quote: the government's recent decision to allow a uniform export quota for sugar has helped stabilize the domestic supply and support sugar prices

items.statement: Industry requested government to increase ethanol procurement prices to match rising cane FRP
items.quote: We also hope that the government will examine the request of matching ethanol prices with the increase in cane prices in this coming financial year.

items.statement: Record cane crushing of 24.6 lakh tons at Sameerwadi in sugar season 2024-25, up YoY vs India decline
items.quote: we recorded our highest ever cane crushing volumes at our Sameerwadi facility, 24.6 lakh tons in the sugar season 2024-25, an increase over the previous year, as opposed to the reduction in cane crushing all across India.

items.statement: Sugar inventory valued at INR34,800 per ton as of 31 March, selling at INR37.5-38 per kg
items.quote: we valued the sugar stock at INR34,800 per ton

items.statement: B-heavy molasses stock of ~1 lakh metric ton available for ethanol production in Q1 FY26
items.quote: we have a B heavy molasses of approximately 1 lakh metric ton. And with that, we can make ethanol from that molasses.

items.statement: Reduced debt, lowering interest burden and creating headroom for expansion
items.quote: We have strengthened our financial position by reducing debt, which has lowered our interest burden and created significant headroom for future expansion and strategic investments.

items.statement: Ethanol segment revenue grew 37% in Q4 FY25 after government restored blending from sugarcane juice/syrup
items.quote: Our ethanol segment delivered an exceptional performance in Q4-25, reflecting revenue growth of 37%.

items.statement: Cancer drug discovery molecule in safety trials, completion expected Q2 FY26; spent ~INR25 crore over 10 years
items.quote: Maybe over the last 10 years, we may have spent in the range of about, INR25 crores over the last 10 years.

items.statement: Preliminary efficacy trials for cancer molecule estimated 2+ years after successful safety trials
items.quote: Our current estimate of preliminary efficacy subject to a successful completion of the safety trials would be in the range of two years, two plus.

items.statement: Bio-based specialty chemicals driven by co-creation with global customers transitioning to renewable supply chains
items.quote: Many global companies remain committed to substitute fossil chemicals with chemicals derived from renewable sources in their supply chain. Godavari Biorefineries is working with many of these global companies to co-create solutions in this transformation.

items.statement: Bio-based specialty chemicals have competition but few competitors, driven by customer partnerships
items.quote: These are typically products which have competition, but few competitors, that is how we work. It is mainly driven by relationship that we work with customers.

items.statement: Capex for biobutanol project to be firmed up after detailed engineering package completed
items.quote: We are working on the detailed engineering package for the same. And when we have that, that will help us to do a much firmer capital expenditure which we can tell you as the update comes through.

items.statement: Debottlenecking of chemical plants ongoing, some completed in Q4 FY25, more through FY26
items.quote: Some of that debottlenecking has already happened, which you saw the result in Q4 2025. And other such debottlenecking will continue during the whole year of FY26.

items.statement: Ethanol procurement prices unchanged since Nov 2022 while FRP increased, pressuring industry margins
items.quote: While the Fair and Remunerative Price, FRP, has steadily increased, the ethanol procurement prices have remained unchanged since November 2022, creating an imbalance that pressured industry margins.

items.statement: Company fulfilled its sugar export quota; unaware of overall industry shipment status
items.quote: Sir, we are not exactly aware. We just know that we have fulfilled our quota.

items.statement: Cancer research collaboration with Dr. Sendurai Mani (USA scientist) for 15 years
items.quote: we started working with Dr. Sendurai Mani who is a scientist in the USA and we started working on that.

items.statement: Management does not provide revenue CAGR guidance for next 2-3 years
items.quote: we as a company have basically taken a position on not providing guidance

items.statement: Monthly transacting truck operators grew 18% YoY to 7.7 lakh in Q4 FY25
items.quote: monthly transacting truck operators on the platform? As I mentioned, that's close to 7.7 lakhs, which was 6.5 lakhs last year, which is growth of about close to 18% on a year -on-year basis

items.statement: Monthly transacting users using at least two services grew 27% YoY
items.quote: monthly transacting users using at least two services grew about close to 27% on a year-on-year basis

items.statement: Gross Transaction Value on payments grew 33% YoY to INR 6,600 crores in Q4 FY25
items.quote: GTV on payments, last year, same quarter, we did close to INR5,000 crores, which grew to about close to INR6,600 crores this quarter, which is a growth of about 33%

items.statement: Full year FY25 GTV on payments grew 35% YoY to INR 23,000 crores
items.quote: on the whole financial year, grew from 17,300 to 23,000, which is a growth of 35%

items.statement: Contribution margin steady at 93% in Q4 FY25 vs 92% YoY
items.quote: Contribution margin profile continues to stay steady, as we discussed in terms of, you know, the nature of revenues continues to remain same. Last year, same quarter was 92%, this year is about close to 93%

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA grew 2.2x YoY to INR 54 crores in Q4 FY25
items.quote: delivering an adjusted EBITDA in this quarter of roughly INR54 crores, which was in the same quarter last year, roughly about INR17 crores, which is roughly a 2.2x growth

items.statement: Full year FY25 adjusted EBITDA grew ~10x to INR 139 crores
items.quote: From a financial year perspective, we delivered INR13.5 crores in adjusted EBITDA in FY24, which grew to 139 crores in FY25

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin reached close to 40% of revenue in Q4 FY25
items.quote: our adjusted EBITDA to revenue. This percentage of adjusted EBITDA has already reached close to 40%

items.statement: Depreciation spike due to one-time accelerated depreciation on CPS devices; normal run-rate INR 8-10 crores per quarter
items.quote: depreciation was on account of it's a one-time, so we did a physical verification like we do at the end of the year and there were some CPS devices where we had to take some accelerated depreciation. Generally, it should stay in the range of the INR8 crores to INR10 crores as we move forward

items.statement: Core businesses (tolling + vehicle tracking) ~85% of revenue; growth businesses ~15%
items.quote: Core and growth put together, we've already disclosed that's roughly close to about 85% of the revenues. And in those payments is the larger revenue vertical, telematics is second

items.statement: Growth businesses revenue grew ~90% YoY in FY25 and ~50% YoY in Q4 FY25
items.quote: Revenue from growth businesses, which removes the core verticals of tolling and vehicle tracking, that grew at roughly about 90% on a year-on-year basis in FY25, and it grew about close to 50% on a year-on-year basis in 4QFY25

items.statement: Fuel sensor sales doubled QoQ in Q4 FY25
items.quote: The last quarter, we were able to double the sales from the previous quarter, which is a good milestone

items.statement: Used PV loan hubs doubled to ~100 in FY25
items.quote: last financial year, we used to operate more close to about 50 hubs. Here, we have doubled the hubs in the last financial year, and we are offering this service in close to 100 hubs

items.statement: Loads brokerage live in 5 hubs, primarily Bangalore; still in playbook building phase
items.quote: we are live in totally five hubs. But yes, I mean, the business is largely in a, you know, playbook building phase

items.statement: Average truck operator fleet size 2-3 trucks; focus on underserved small operators
items.quote: an average between two to three trucks. Small, small truck operators

items.statement: Telematics market share ~30% of monthly device sales; fuel sensor share ~40-45%
items.quote: we are probably able to capture roughly close to about 30% of those devices. This is on the vehicle tracking side. And on the fuel sensor side, also probably this will be a bit more, probably more than the 40%, 40%-45% range

items.statement: Telematics + fuel sensor combo price to customer INR 8,000-10,000; price has come down
items.quote: Combo cost to the customer will be between 8 to, yeah, between depending on cus tomer to customer, this is volume discount between 8000 to 10,000

items.statement: Received in-principle PPI license approval in Q4 FY25; will take few quarters to operationalize
items.quote: we've received the in-principle approval for the PPI license in the last quarter and it will take us probably in a few quarters to operationalize that

items.statement: No mention of debt raise or repayment; focus on internal cash generation
items.quote: every quarter, think of it as whatever EBITDA we deliver, that's the cash we generate

items.statement: ESOP charge negative in Q4 due to employee exits and attrition estimate changes; future schedule provided in earnings deck
items.quote: if let's say an employee leaves, then that ESOP get s surrendered and then there is a reversal. Second, there are some changes in estimates in terms of attrition, et cetera

items.statement: Discontinued operations charge in Q4 FY25 is final; contingent obligation closed in February
items.quote: we have cleared all of that out, that obligation closed in February. So, this is the last charge that we will have on this particular piece

items.statement: No fixed cost increase expected from PPI license; same team will build and manage stack internally
items.quote: there is not going to be any fixed increase in fixed overhead. It is still the same team, same technology team, same product team is going to build and manage the same stack, you know, internally

items.statement: Distribution network: 10,000 touchpoints across 85% of districts
items.quote: We have a 10,000 people touchpoint network all across the country. We have presence in 85% of the districts today

items.statement: Tolling market share increased from 37% to 45.5% in FY25; continue to gain share monthly
items.quote: We ended with -- we started the year with 37. We ended the last year with 37. This year we ended at roughly 45.5

items.statement: AIS telematics device ICAT certified; own design and supply chain; lowest cost manufacturer in India
items.quote: we've developed the new hardware from scratch, which has got ICAT certified, so that will be a BlackBuck device from an ownership perspective end-to-end

items.statement: FY26 revenue target INR2,200-2,400 crore including EPC
items.quote: For the current year, we are not seeing any major issues and we are targeting the turnover to range between INR2,200 crores to INR2,400 crores.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target INR3,000-3,400 crore with 4 GW module capacity
items.quote: Just on the basis of the 4 gigawatt of module line, the turnaround will be between INR3,000 crores to INR3,400 crores, which will include INR200 crore of EPC business also.

items.statement: Current 1.5 GW module capacity, adding 2.5 GW by October for total 4 GW
items.quote: We have two production line operational and another 2.5 gigawatt is getting added from September end, which will be the beginning of October. So we will have a cumulative capacity of 4 gigawatt by that time.

items.statement: Cell line 2 GW planned, 18 months from zero date
items.quote: It takes 18 months, you can consider from the zero date.

items.statement: Current debt ~INR400 crore; peak debt ~INR1,400 crore by FY27
items.quote: So around INR400 crores plus INR1,000, so INR1,400 crores.

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA 11.4%, PAT 6.4% vs guided 9-11% EBITDA and 5% PAT
items.quote: Current financial year our EBITDA is around INR11.5% and PAT is 6.4%. So, I think so we have outperformed what was our estimate. We had estimated the EBITDA margin between 9% to 11%. We are at 11.4.

items.statement: Module price pass-through clauses in contracts for cell price, dollar, policy changes
items.quote: All the contracts are, having the clause of change in a government laws, a change in fluctuation in prices and the dollar, w ith these are the all orders are linked to the dollars also

items.statement: Exports to Germany, Africa; targeting US market next year
items.quote: Previous year, we did export small numbers to Europe, particularly Germany and Africa and now we have set our focus to the USA market. And so basically, we are looking forward to have some good orders coming in from the US market next year.

items.statement: Indian module capacity 100+ GW but actual throughput lower; new players need ramp-up time; Solex edge in technology and reliability
items.quote: when we say we have a 100 gigawatt module manufacturing capacity, the actual throughput will be much lesser than 100 gigawatt. And these are the new players which are coming. So they will take their own time to ramp up and reach to that optimized

items.statement: Equity raise of INR500 crore for cell/module expansion within 2-3 months
items.quote: We are approaching investors to raise. So I think so within 2 to 3 months, we will be approaching investors to raise this INR500 crores.

items.statement: Mainboard migration delayed due to ESM status; cooling period required
items.quote: Currently, we are under ESM. So that's the reason the migration to the mainboard got delayed. Once we are done with this, then there is some cooling period and then the migration will happen.
